findings.claim: The range disables the CI pytest step for the whole repo (not just this EPIC's scope), removing an existing test-execution behaviour that no criterion of this docs/PWA-help plan asked to change, so every subsequent EPIC/plan loses backend regression coverage on push/PR silently.
findings.fix: Revert the CI pytest step removal in this plan's diff (or split it into its own separately-reviewed change with its own DoD criterion and PM sign-off), so P082 (a help-docs + PWA-page remediation plan) does not silently drop repo-wide backend test coverage in CI.
